player_prompt.intro:
O iko o Player {player_id} ena Quantum Tic Tac Toe.
Na nomu symbol e '{symbol}', kei na nomu move numbers e sa {parity} (e.g., X1, X3 or O2, O4).

Goal: Win by forming a line of three classical marks (solidified from superpositions).

How to Play:
- Ena nomu turn, tara na spooky mark ena dua na empty squares using na format '[a,b]'.
- Na marks oqo e entangled, kei labeled me 'X1 / X1' or 'O4 / O4'.
- O na tara spooky marks ena square e sa collapse oqo (solidified).

Collapse Rule:
- Ya nomu move e create a cycle ena entanglement graph, e collapse automatically.
- Na spooky mark ena cycle e turn into a classical mark ena dua na positions.
- Na dependent spooky marks e collapse talega.

Victory:
- Na game e muri ena nomu player e tara three classical marks ena row.
- Ya both players get a line ena same collapse, na player e sa tara na lower max move number e win.

Example move: '[0,4]' e tara na spooky mark ena cells 0 kei 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Na kena ibulibuli e sega ni dodonu. Vakayagataka na "[a,b]".
invalid_move.invalid_cells: Na idusidusi ni sela e sega ni dodonu se tautauvata.
invalid_move.already_solidified: Dua na sela e sa kaukaua tu.

game_action.placed: Player {player_id} e tara na symbol ena superposition ena kelekele ni cells {pos_a} kei {pos_b}.

game_message.dependent_resolved: Dependent superposition resolved. Cell ({r}, {c}) e sa tara kina oqo {symbol}.
game_message.last_cell_resolved: Superposition ni last cell resolved. Cell ({r}, {c}) e sa tara kina oqo {symbol}.
game_message.superposition_resolved: Superposition resolved. Cell ({r}, {c}) e sa tara kina oqo {symbol}.

outcome.win: Na dauqito {player_id} ena qaqa ni sa dei na nona maka!
